name: gtmos-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for GTMOS, Tam To Target's go-to-market operating system.

plugins.name: gtmos-insights
plugins.description: Read-only GTMOS: calls, transcripts, meetings, email and campaign performance for the accounts your login can see. Cannot change anything.

plugins.name: gtmos-ops
plugins.description: Internal GTMOS operations for Tam To Target staff: client data, lead loading, DNC and ops checks. Needs a GTMOS API token; what you can do follows its scopes.
